current.description: Current sale price for the product, when available.

original.description: Original or list price before discount, when available.

reviews.description: Number of product reviews, when available.

logoUrl.description: Shop logo image URL, when available.

items.description: A normalized TikTok Shop search result product.

products.description: Products returned for the requested page.

page.description: Pagination state for the current response.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.

meta.description: Metadata describing the request and billing outcome.
